text:
# filter.conditionIn

TL;DR:
- filter.conditionIn selects one or more exact condition buckets.

What it means:
- It is the discrete-set version of condition filtering.

Agent hint:
- Use this when the workflow knows specific acceptable condition buckets, not just a min/max band.
